description: Reduce background activity and optional consumer features. Some settings may be edition- or version-dependent.

policies.name: Prevent Windows Apps from Running in Background
policies.description: Force-denies background execution for packaged Windows apps. May delay notifications and background sync; does not stop all desktop applications.

policies.name: Disable Microsoft Consumer Experiences
policies.description: Disables Microsoft consumer experience suggestions and automatic promotional app provisioning where supported. Does not remove existing apps.

policies.name: Disable Windows Game Recording and Broadcasting
policies.description: Disables Windows Game DVR recording/broadcasting where supported; does not uninstall Xbox Game Bar.

policies.name: Turn Off Windows Copilot (Legacy Policy)
policies.description: Legacy Windows Copilot policy; may not affect newer Copilot app releases or all Windows 11 versions.
